$Comment: Percent of knockback the carrier shrugs off, in whole percent points (25 takes a quarter off every knockback). Any item's StatModifiers raise it like any stat, and so does an effect's RawStatModifiers. ziggfreed-common carries the total to the engine as one hidden effect whose KnockbackMultiplier is 1 minus this percent, held between 0 and the cap this file's ZigCeiling tag names (80, so a hit still moves the carrier; nothing raises it, and a server changes it by shipping this file with another value), so it multiplies with every other knockback effect the carrier has. Base 0; Min is a generous negative so a subtractive modifier never clamps.
